scripts.dev: node -e "console.log('Use: npm run dev:marketing, npm run dev:portal, or npm run dev:worker')"
scripts.build: node -e "console.log('Use: npm run build:marketing, npm run build:portal, or npm run build:worker')"
scripts.build:portal: npm run portal:build-env && npm --prefix apps/portal run build
scripts.start: node -e "console.log('Use: npm run start:marketing, npm run start:portal, or npm run start:worker')"
scripts.portal:auth-runtime: npm run portal:auth-env && npx playwright test playwright/portal.auth-runtime.spec.ts --project=portal-chromium
scripts.portal:agent-access: npm run portal:auth-env && npx playwright test playwright/portal.agent-access.spec.ts --project=portal-chromium
scripts.portal:agent-access:provision: npm run portal:test-user:ensure && npm run portal:agent-access
scripts.workbench:capture:verify: npm run portal:auth-env && PORTAL_PAGE_DEBUG_EXPORTS=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_PORTAL_PAGE_DEBUG_EXPORTS=1 ENABLE_SANCTUARY_GEOMETRY_WORKBENCH_FIXTURES=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_SANCTUARY_GEOMETRY_WORKBENCH_FIXTURES=1 npx playwright test playwright/workbench.capture-verify.spec.ts --project=portal-chromium --reporter=line
scripts.portal:side-effects: npm run test:portal:quotes && npm run build:portal
scripts.lint: npm run docs:guard && npm run packages:guard && npm run cache:forbid && npm run brand:forbid && npm run text:mojibake && eslint .
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/marketing/tsconfig.json --noEmit --incremental false && tsc -p apps/portal/tsconfig.json --noEmit --incremental false && tsc -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit --incremental false && tsc -p packages/costing/tsconfig.typecheck.json --noEmit --incremental false && tsc -p packages/email-provider/tsconfig.typecheck.json --noEmit --incremental false && tsc -p packages/geometry/tsconfig.typecheck.json --noEmit --incremental false && tsc -p packages/jobs/tsconfig.typecheck.json --noEmit --incremental false && tsc -p packages/quote-format/tsconfig.typecheck.json --noEmit --incremental false && tsc -p packages/theme/tsconfig.typecheck.json --noEmit --incremental false
scripts.test:jobs: vitest run packages/jobs packages/email-provider test/background-jobs-migration.test.ts test/repo-security.test.ts
scripts.test:email-integrations: vitest run apps/portal/lib/emails/sendTransactionalEmail.test.ts apps/portal/lib/backgroundJobs apps/portal/app/api/webhooks/resend apps/marketing/lib/email apps/marketing/app/api/contact apps/marketing/app/api/enquiry
scripts.test:portal:schedule: vitest run apps/portal/app/staff/schedule apps/portal/app/api/staff/v1/schedule apps/portal/lib/scheduling && npm run schedule:bundle-budget
scripts.test:portal:workbench: vitest run apps/portal/components/drawings apps/portal/lib/drawings "apps/portal/app/staff/projects/[projectId]/design-workbench" apps/portal/components/estimates/EstimateDrawingSheet.test.tsx && npm run test:portal:browser
scripts.test:portal:projects: vitest run apps/portal/app/staff/contacts apps/portal/app/staff/projects apps/portal/app/api/contacts apps/portal/app/api/projects apps/portal/app/api/estimates apps/portal/lib/contacts apps/portal/lib/projects apps/portal/lib/estimates apps/portal/lib/localFirst apps/portal/components/sync apps/portal/components/projects/ProjectPage
scripts.test:portal:quotes: vitest run apps/portal/app/api/quotes apps/portal/app/api/staff/v1/quotes apps/portal/app/api/staff/v1/invoices apps/portal/app/api/staff/v1/job-packs apps/portal/lib/quotes apps/portal/lib/invoices apps/portal/lib/emails apps/portal/lib/jobPacks
scripts.test:portal:shell: vitest run apps/portal/app/access-status apps/portal/app/dashboard apps/portal/app/error.test.tsx apps/portal/components/auth apps/portal/components/layout apps/portal/components/navigation apps/portal/components/page-state apps/portal/components/ui
scripts.test:portal:smoke: npm run portal:auth-runtime && npx playwright test playwright/portal.auth-routing.spec.ts --project=portal-chromium
scripts.test:portal:performance: npm run portal:auth-runtime && npx playwright test playwright/portal.performance.spec.ts --project=portal-chromium
scripts.test:portal:performance:fixture: npm run portal:fixture-env && npx playwright test playwright/portal.workbench-performance.spec.ts playwright/portal.project-mutation-performance.spec.ts --project=portal-fixture --workers=1
scripts.audit:lighthouse: npm run audit:lighthouse:mobile && npm run audit:lighthouse:desktop
scripts.audit:governance: npm run test:marketing && npm run audit:security && npm run audit:lighthouse
scripts.portal:doctor:quick: npm run docs:guard && npm run text:mojibake && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:portal
scripts.portal:doctor: npm run portal:doctor:quick && npm run build:portal && npm run portal:bundle-budget && npm run test:portal:browser && npm run test:portal:performance:fixture && npm run portal:auth-runtime && npm run test:portal:smoke && npm run test:portal:performance && npm run audit:security
scripts.test:portal:browser:auth: npm run portal:auth-env && playwright test playwright/portal.auth.setup.ts --project=setup
scripts.portal:agent-scenarios: npm run portal:auth-env && npx playwright test playwright/portal.agent-scenarios.spec.ts --project=portal-chromium
scripts.portal:agent-scenarios:provision: npm run portal:test-user:ensure && npm run portal:scenarios:ensure && npm run portal:agent-scenarios
scripts.portal:calculator-ui: npm run portal:auth-env && npx playwright test playwright/portal.calculator.spec.ts --project=portal-chromium
scripts.portal:calculator-ui:provision: npm run portal:test-user:ensure && npm run portal:scenarios:ensure && npm run portal:calculator-ui
